About.title: About Anime2Cap
About.question: <bold>Anime2Cap</bold> exists to answer a question every fan has asked:
About.quote: "I finished episode X. Which chapter should I continue from in the manga?"
About.description: Instead of hunting for answers in forums and getting spoilers, you find everything here in seconds. Our goal is to facilitate your transition between media in a precise and direct way.
About.searchDesc: Type the anime name and get results instantly, without reloading the page.
About.conversionDesc: We map episodes and chapters with a focus on absolute precision, identifying what is <canon>Canon</canon> and what is <filler>Filler</filler>.
About.footerNote: Our focus is your experience. No technical jargon, no distractions. Just the information you need to continue your journey in the world of manga.

CookieConsent.title: Privacy & Cookies
CookieConsent.description: We use cookies and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity) to improve your experience. No data is collected before your consent.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At Anime2Cap, we take your privacy seriously. This policy details how we use analytics tools to improve your experience.
Privacy.sec1Content: We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to understand site traffic and Microsoft Clarity to analyze user behavior through heatmaps and full session recordings (mouse movements, clicks, scroll, and typed text). These scripts are only loaded after your explicit consent through the cookie banner.
Privacy.sec2Content: We use cookies to provide essential features and collect analytical data. In the future, we may display ads through Google AdSense, which uses cookies to serve ads based on your previous visits.
Privacy.sec3Content: Collected data is anonymous and focused on performance metrics. You can choose to disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.
Privacy.sec4Content: Anime data is provided via Jikan API. Error monitoring is performed by Sentry.io with active filtering of personal data. Google acts as a data processor for analytics and advertising — see Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy. Additionally, security logs containing IP addresses for detecting and preventing abusive behaviors, suspicious access, or vulnerability scans are retained for a maximum period of 90 days based on our legitimate interest in system security, being automatically deleted thereafter.
Privacy.sec5Content: In compliance with LGPD and GDPR, we ensure that no sensitive personal data is stored without your explicit consent. You have the right to request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us at: pontuswebstudio@gmail.com.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.sec1Content: By using Anime2Cap, you agree to the collection of anonymous analytical data as described in our Privacy Policy.
Terms.sec2Content: Anime2Cap is an information tool. We are not responsible for decisions made based on conversion data, which is provided 'as is'.
Terms.sec3Content: The use of bots or scrapers to extract massive data from our database without prior authorization is prohibited.
Terms.sec4Content: In compliance with LGPD, you may request deletion, correction, or portability of your data at any time. Contact us at: pontuswebstudio@gmail.com.
